records.text: Inside American Education by Thomas Sowell is a must-read book that explains how the public school system came together with its decline, deception, and dogmas, and how they are programming children
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I tell people a must-read book is Inside American Education by Thomas Sowell. It is not left or right. He is just telling you how it all came together—the decline, the deception, the dogmas—and how they are programming our children.

records.text: Owens alleged that Ben Shapiro arranged a Thomas Sowell interview as an opportunity to hurt her feelings after learning she admired Sowell
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So when Ben saw that, he decided, Thomas Sowell, hey, that's your dream. You love Thomas Sowell. He thought that was an opportunity to get even with me ... Ben had his team reach out and schedule an interview with Thomas Sowell. ... to hurt my feelings, okay?

records.text: Owens said Ben Shapiro had his team schedule a Thomas Sowell interview after her Tucker Carlson appearance and presumed they paid an offensive amount for it
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Ben had his team reach out and schedule an interview with Thomas Sowell. which they paid for an offensive amount of money, I presume ... Interview with Tucker is on the 15th, I think it premieres on the 16th, and Ben gets Thomas Sowell

verification.notes: Public metadata establishes the sequence: Owens interview with Carlson on November 15 and Shapiro interview with Sowell on November 17. No source found establishes that Shapiro scheduled the interview in response to Owens, that it was newly arranged after her appearance, or that Sowell was paid an offensive amount. The revised statement separates the confirmed sequence from Owens allegation about motive and payment.
